title: Help desk orchestrator with two Strands specialists
scenario: Lighthouse's first agent is an employee help desk: an orchestrator routes to an IT specialist and an access-review specialist exposed as tools. Security requires an audit record for every tool call and a hard block on delete_* tools; finance wants a cap on model calls per request. Runs offline with a scripted Strands model.
task: Validated, trimmed tools with errors the model can act on
AuditHook and delete_* block on every agent; BudgetHook on model calls
Agents as tools: per-specialist model, prompt, tools and hooks
Requester from the session, never from tool arguments
acceptance: Routing, scoping and validation tests pass
delete_* never runs; budget stops loops at both levels
ANSWER.md argues hooks vs prompts and the multi-agent pattern choice
